title: TAT-3632 — MM Pay Perps withdrawal blocks on a fresh balance
description: Proves the MM Pay Perps withdrawal alert decides from a fresh account-state read instead of the streamed WebSocket cache: reproduces the live streamed-vs-fresh divergence in the running extension, then asserts the hook's blocking decision, its non-Perps scoping, and its degraded-read behaviour. Preconditions: Extension runtime reachable over CDP on the slot port, wallet fixture unlocked. Perps provider reachable with a non-zero fresh withdrawable balance on the selected account (testnet Hyperliquid, Account 1). Probe runs from a non-Perps screen so nothing re-subscribes the streamed account channel.

setup-status.intent: Resolve the Extension checkout and adapter status before the proof

setup-cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Ensure the fixture-backed wallet is unlocked

setup-warm-streamed-cache.intent: Open Perps so the streamed account channel populates its cache, matching a user who has already browsed Perps

setup-leave-perps.intent: Return to a non-Perps screen, where nothing re-subscribes the streamed account channel

ac3-probe-live-balance-divergence.intent: AC3: restart the UI realm (MV3-restart equivalent) and read the streamed cache and the fresh account state side by side, read-only

ac3-assert-streamed-cache-empty.intent: AC3: the streamed account cache the old hook read is empty after the UI restart

ac3-assert-balances-diverge.intent: AC3: the streamed balance and the fresh account-state balance disagree in the live runtime

ac3-assert-decisions-disagree.intent: AC3: that divergence flips the withdrawal decision, so the source the hook reads changes the outcome

ac3-verify-blocking-under-divergence.cmd: yarn jest ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/usePerpsWithdrawInsufficientBalanceAlert.test.ts --no-coverage -t 'fresh balance source blocks a withdrawal the stale streamed cache would have allowed' --json --outputFile=temp/tasks/fix/tat-3632-0803-221700/artifacts/ac3-jest.json
ac3-verify-blocking-under-divergence.intent: AC3: exercise the confirmation alert with a stale-high streamed balance and a lower fresh balance

ac3-assert-blocking-no-failures.intent: AC3: the invalid withdrawal is blocked when the streamed cache would have allowed it

ac3-assert-blocking-test-ran.intent: AC3: exactly the stale-high blocking case ran, so the pass is not an empty filter

ac3-open-perps-balance.intent: AC3: return to Perps to show the live balance the fresh read resolved to

ac3-wait-for-fresh-balance.intent: AC3: wait for the live Perps balance readout before capturing it

ac3-screenshot-live-fresh-balance.label: AC3: live Perps balance matching the fresh account-state read
ac3-screenshot-live-fresh-balance.intent: AC3: orientation capture of the real account balance the probe read as the fresh source

ac1-run-fresh-balance-tests.intent: AC1: run the stale-high, stale-low, fresh-equal and loading cases for the fresh account-state decision

ac1-assert-no-failures.intent: AC1: the blocking decision follows the fresh account-state result in every case

ac1-assert-cases-ran.intent: AC1: all four fresh-balance cases ran, so the pass is not an empty filter

ac2-run-perps-scope-tests.intent: AC2: run the non-Perps isolation, scope-change and request-coalescing cases plus both degraded-read cases

ac2-assert-no-failures.intent: AC2: non-Perps confirmations never query Perps, and a degraded read fails safe without inventing a balance

ac2-assert-cases-ran.intent: AC2: all five scoping and degraded-read cases ran, so the pass is not an empty filter
